title: Sphere described as a control mechanism that interacts with consciousness
summary: Randy Anderson tells of Sphere described as a control mechanism that interacts with consciousness, about 2014 at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: I do remember them saying that it was potentially part of a control mechanism and that it interacted with conscious

plain: Randy Anderson tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in 2014, at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a Navy research site in Indiana, he saw a sphere he believes was alien technology. He remembers people there saying it might be part of a control system that responded to human consciousness, which, if true, would mean a machine driven by the mind.
